page: Microsoft Azure L64s_v3 is an LSv3-family server instance configured with 64 vCPUs and 32 physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8370C processor running at 2.8 GHz. It features 512.0 GB of system memory, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance is bundled with 16,015 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and supports Premium Storage. It operates on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor using the x86_64 architecture.

Benchmark results indicate strong multi-core capabilities, with stress-ng multi-core CPU performance, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU scores all placing in the top 25%. Memory performance is also strong, particularly in large-block uncached read and write operations. The server demonstrates high throughput in database operations, Redis SET operations, and static web serving, all ranking in the top 25%. However, single-core performance is average, as shown by stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core scores.

While the server excels at multi-threaded tasks, software compilation, and high-throughput database operations, it exhibits limitations in large-scale AI workloads. Large language model inference text generation for a 70B model falls into the bottom 25% of benchmarks. Given the high local NVMe storage capacity and strong database benchmarks, this instance is designed for storage-intensive workloads, large databases, Redis caching layers, and multi-threaded data processing rather than heavy LLM text generation.
